description: Sleeps and naps with performance, efficiency, consistency, stage breakdown (light/deep/REM/awake), disturbances, respiratory rate and sleep need, most recent first.

days.description: Shortcut for start: look back this many days from now. Ignored when start is set.

end.description: Upper bound: a date (YYYY-MM-DD) includes that whole day; a date-time is exclusive. Defaults to now.

include_naps.description: Set false to return only main sleeps.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

next_token.description: Pass the next_token from a previous call to get the following records.

raw.description: Return WHOOP's raw API objects instead of compact summaries with friendly units.

start.description: Inclusive lower bound: a date (YYYY-MM-DD, local midnight) or ISO 8601 date-time.

name: list_sleeps
title: List sleeps
